directive_section: Section 6, MG-013; Section 1.2 binding choice 10 (tiny universal typography thresholds superseded)
measurement_basis: Sizes are pixels at the destination. Every measurement is taken with the actual font file and weight named by the job, parsed from that font binary (units per em, per-glyph advances, cap height, weight class). Floors are judged on the effective displayed size: for a full-frame or recomposed canvas, the authored size on that canvas; for an inset placement, the authored size multiplied by destination width over source canvas width. The floor itself never scales down. Cap height in pixels is reported with every measurement; a font whose cap-height ratio is unusually small earns a reviewer warning, not a silent pass.
overflow_law: If essential copy cannot fit above its role floor, shorten it or split it. Shrinking below the floor is never a solution and the fit decider is structurally incapable of returning one.

roles.measurement_basis: Font size at destination plus cap height; judged at effective displayed size.
roles.purpose: States the one idea of the frame or beat; the largest text after a hero number.

roles.measurement_basis: Font size at destination plus cap height; judged at effective displayed size.
roles.purpose: A single commanding figure the beat exists to land (a total, a price, a count).

roles.measurement_basis: Font size at destination plus cap height; judged at effective displayed size.
roles.purpose: Support copy the viewer must read to understand the beat: the explanation under a headline, the claim beside a chart.

roles.measurement_basis: Font size at destination plus cap height; judged at effective displayed size.
roles.purpose: The call to action. Audited at its destination size on the final placement, never at source size.

roles.measurement_basis: Font size at the chart's destination size; the chart is audited where it will be placed, not at authoring size.
roles.purpose: Names a chart category, series, or row. Chart-internal role: it is read as part of the chart, whose headline carries the message. Calibrated so the shipped C05 design record (label 60-64 px) passes.

roles.measurement_basis: Font size at the chart's destination size; judged at effective displayed size.
roles.purpose: Prints the exact data value. The value is the data, so this role is essential and never an exception candidate. Calibrated so the shipped C05 design record (value 64-72 px) passes.

exception.bound: May carry only the honesty or source line for the data or claim shown (for example that figures are illustrative, or the source of a statistic). It may never carry message copy, a claim, or an instruction. Essential content found in this role is mis-roled and must be promoted to essential_support. Its effective size is still audited at destination; small print is a bounded convention, not an exemption from measurement.

roles.measurement_basis: Font size at destination; judged at effective displayed size against the disclosure floor.
roles.purpose: The honesty and source line under data. Calibrated so the shipped C05 design record (disclosure 48 px) passes.

exception.bound: Tick labels may sit below the essential floors only when every value they show is also carried by a chart_value, a chart_category_label, or an axis title at an essential size. A tick may never be the sole carrier of a value the viewer needs.

roles.measurement_basis: Font size at the chart's destination size; judged against the exception floor.
roles.purpose: Axis graduations and grid numbers inside a chart.

exception.bound: May carry only metadata: timestamps, source attributions, slide or page numbers, speaker names under a talking head. The moment metadata becomes a claim or an instruction, it must be re-roled as essential_support or cta.

roles.measurement_basis: Font size at destination; judged against the exception floor.
roles.purpose: Nonessential labels whose absence changes nothing the viewer understands.

exception.bound: Pure ornament: section furniture, repeated brand words, background words. Carries no information. If removing it would remove information, it is mis-roled and the audit treats the role claim as invalid.

roles.measurement_basis: Font size at destination; judged against the exception floor.
roles.purpose: Decorative text that is design texture, not content.

statement: These size ranges are BlackCEO design defaults for motion graphics composed at the 1920x1080 reference canvas. They are not universal accessibility standards and are not presented as such. When fonts have different cap heights or narrow counters, the reviewer may demand a larger size than the default range for the same role.
substitution_law: The requested family and weight must be the family and weight that render. A missing font file, a family mismatch, or a weight mismatch is a reported finding. Measurement never falls back to a different font and calls it the requested one.
